newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech c.bank offers 26-wk T-bills at max 11.95 pct.
newsitem.headline: Czech c.bank offers 26-wk T-bills at max 11.95 pct.

text.p: The Czech National Bank said on Tuesday it would hold a Dutch auction offering five billion crowns in 26-week Finance Ministry treasury bills on Wednesday, with maximum gross yield on bids set at 11.95 percent.
Gross yield in an auction of similar bills at the end of February was 11.9 percent, down from 12.23 percent in January, and was oversubscribed with bids totalling 6.61 billion crowns.
